verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer a rules or automation engine, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-definable event-triggered rules. Payment notification webhooks (HTTP POST to a Notification URL, with retries) are a developer building block for constructing automation, not a rules feature. Vendor-built 'smart retry logic' and automatic recurring Pix debit are fixed product behaviors, not rules a user defines.
